crossing_definition: an imagined trajectory 'crosses' iff some imagined state has x >= x_wall during the planner's horizon-40 rollout on the blind model; identical to scripts/continuous_cem.py
interval_method: Clopper-Pearson (exact binomial); Wilson two-sided upper reported alongside for reference

mu_query_lower_bound_from_first_plan.argument: an initial-state-scope plan is the episode's first plan; {first plan crosses} implies {mu_query event}, so this is a valid lower confidence bound on mu_query(E)
